AttemptIn.description: `POST /api/attempts`: one round answered, sent once the round is over (or left).
AttemptIn.title: AttemptIn

Config.description: A session's settings, snapshotted when it starts (§15 "consent/config snapshot"), so a replay uses the same.
Config.title: Config

Event.description:
An attempt as the log keeps it: what the database holds and what an export carries, so a replay from either
goes through the same code.
Event.title: Event

EvidenceRow.description: One attempt as it bears on one skill: the provenance behind an estimate.
EvidenceRow.title: EvidenceRow

Export.description: Everything held about one learner (§17), and the estimates made from it, so a rebuild can be checked.
Export.title: Export

FirstAnswer.description: The first answer given: one option's id (a one-tap round), or where each piece was at the first check.
FirstAnswer.title: FirstAnswer

Logged.description: A decision as stored and exported: the choice, where it was made and when.
Logged.title: Logged

Mode.description:
A kind of round: one template each, plus Mixed. The first five are the original rounds (their ids are kept, so
saved settings still name them).
Mode.title: Mode

Next.description:
`POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/next`: a round to play (`round`, checked, with its tries), an offered break, or the
end of the session, with the rationale codes, the same in words for a grown-up, and what else was weighed.
Next.title: Next

Profile.description: `GET /api/learners/{id}/profile`: the learner, what was recorded and every skill's estimates and state.
Profile.title: Profile

ReplayIn.description:
`POST /api/v1/evaluations/replay`: the policy to replay with (only the current one is kept) and the data, one of
a learner's records or a simulation.
ReplayIn.title: ReplayIn

SessionInfo.description: `POST /api/v1/sessions`: the session, the policy that will plan it and the settings it runs with.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

Why.description: Rationale codes (§15 "validated item + rationale codes"): what a decision is for.
Why.title: Why
